title: Countries and Places
text:
Spain is a country in Europe. It has mountains, rivers and long beaches. The capital city is Madrid. Many people visit Spain every year to see the sea and the old towns.

Chile is a country in South America. It is very long and thin. In the north there is a desert. In the south there are lakes, forests and mountains.

questions.text: What is the capital city of Spain?
What is in the north of Chile?

questions.text: What can we infer about the old towns in Spain?
options: Many visitors want to see them

paragraph_translations: España es un país de Europa. Tiene montañas, ríos y playas largas. La capital es Madrid. Muchas personas visitan España cada año para ver el mar y las ciudades antiguas.
Chile es un país de América del Sur. Es muy largo y delgado. En el norte hay un desierto. En el sur hay lagos, bosques y montañas.
